theorems.statement: ∀ (N m : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid N)) (y : Euclid N) (f : Euclid N → ℝ) (A : Set (Euclid N)) (L L' : ℝ), Continuous f → (∀ w, 0 ≤ f w) → (∀ w, f w ≤ 1) → (∀ w, w ∉ A → f w = 0) → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (r ^ m)⁻¹ * ∫ z, f (r⁻¹ • (z - y)) ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 L) → L' < L → ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (L' * r ^ m) ≤ μ {z | r⁻¹ • (z - y) ∈ A}
